captions.instagram:
On F-1 or J-1 and filed a regular Form 1040 because your tax app didn't offer anything else? It's a common mistake, and there's a set way to fix it.

✔️ File Form 1040-X, the IRS form for correcting a return.
✔️ Attach a corrected Form 1040-NR with "Amended" written across the top.
✔️ Nonresidents generally can't claim education credits, so those come off.
✔️ Some popular tax apps don't support Form 1040-NR at all. Check before you file next year.

We prepare Form 1040-NR returns (student package with Form 8843 and a tax-treaty check). Book a call about fixing a past filing. Not available for CT, MD or OR state returns.

Tax information only, not immigration advice.

sources.fact: Use Form 1040-X if you should have filed Form 1040 instead of Form 1040-NR, or vice versa; complete the corrected return, write "Amended" across the top, attach it to Form 1040-X (Instructions for Form 1040-X, Rev. 12/2025, read 2026-10-25)
Generally, nonresident aliens are not eligible to claim education credits (IRS VITA foreign student module, read 2026-10-24)
TurboTax doesn't support IRS Form 1040-NR (Intuit help article, read 2026-10-24)
Substantial presence test: 31 days this year and 183 days over 3 years (1, 1/3, 1/6); days as an exempt individual (F/J/M/Q students) don't count (read 2026-10-24)
